sights.summary: The great Minoan palace, home of the legend of the Minotaur.

sights.name: Heraklion Archaeological Museum
sights.summary: The world's finest Minoan collection, including the real frescoes of Knossos.

sights.name: Venetian harbor and Koules fortress
sights.summary: The sea fortress built by Venice to guard Crete.

sights.summary: The church of Titus, Paul's companion and the first bishop of Crete.

sights.name: Agios Minas Cathedral

sights.name: 1866 Street market
sights.summary: A lively market street of herbs, honey, cheese and raki.
